name: reactions
title: Reactions
description: The room's pulse while someone talks. Phones tap a reaction (`ReactionBar`) and the shared screen lets it float up (`ReactionStream`); someone who wants to speak raises a hand (`RaiseHand`) and the host calls on people in the order they asked (`HandQueue`).
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/reactions

Installed to `components/ui/games/reactions.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/reactions';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/reactions

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
